lessons.title: 请您把姓名和手机号写在这儿

exercises.point: 用“吗”的是非问句 · Yes/no questions with 吗
exercises.es: Is your name Ma Dawei?
exercises.rule: Statement + 吗 = yes/no question. The word order does not change.

exercises.point: 用“吗”的是非问句 · Yes/no questions with 吗
exercises.prompt: 你很忙。
exercises.es: Are you busy?
exercises.rule: In questions with 吗, 很 is usually dropped.
accepted: 你忙吗？
你忙不忙？
你很忙吗？

exercises.point: 形容词谓语句 · Adjectival predicate
exercises.es: I'm fine.
exercises.rule: The adjective is the predicate, without 是. In affirmative sentences 很 is usually added (with almost no meaning).

exercises.point: 形容词谓语句 · Adjectival predicate
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 我是很忙。
exercises.es: I'm very busy.
exercises.rule: With an adjectival predicate, 是 is not used (except for emphasis: 我是很忙！).
accepted: 我很忙。

exercises.point: 形容词谓语句 · Adjectival predicate
exercises.prompt: 我很忙。
exercises.es: I'm not busy.
exercises.rule: Negative: 不 + adjective (很 is dropped).
accepted: 我不忙。

exercises.point: 副词“也”的位置 · Position of 也
exercises.es: Lin Na is happy too.
exercises.rule: 也 goes after the subject and before the verb/adjective.

exercises.point: 副词“也”的位置 · Position of 也
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 也我很好。
exercises.es: I'm fine too.
exercises.rule: 也 never goes before the subject or on its own.
accepted: 我也很好。

exercises.point: 副词“也”的位置 · Position of 也
exercises.prompt: 不 / 也 / 忙 / 力波
exercises.es: Libo isn't busy either.
exercises.rule: Order: 也 + 不 + adjective.
exercises.context: Libo isn't busy either.
accepted: 力波也不忙。

exercises.prompt: He knows me, but I don't know him.
exercises.pinyin: Tā rènshi wǒ, wǒ bú rènshi tā.
exercises.rule: Chinese has no inflection: word order (subject + verb + object) gives the meaning. 我/他 don't change form.
accepted: 他认识我，我不认识他。

exercises.prompt: Politely invite someone to come in.
exercises.es: Come in, please!
exercises.rule: 请 + verb = polite request.
accepted: 请进！

exercises.prompt: How have you been lately?
exercises.rule: ……怎么样？ asks about the state of something/someone.
accepted: 你最近怎么样？

exercises.point: Tones of 一 and 不
exercises.prompt: 一起 / 一下 / 一天 / 第一
exercises.rule: 一 → yí before a 4th tone; yì before 1st, 2nd and 3rd tones; yī on its own, when counting, or as an ordinal.

exercises.point: Tones of 一 and 不
exercises.prompt: 不是 / 不去 / 不忙 / 不好
exercises.answer: bú shì / bú qù / bù máng / bù hǎo
exercises.rule: 不 → bú before a 4th tone; otherwise bù.

exercises.es: Those aren't jiaozi.
exercises.rule: 是 links two nouns/pronouns. Negative: 不是.

exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 我没是美国人。
exercises.es: I'm not American.
exercises.rule: 是 is always negated with 不, never with 没.
accepted: 我不是美国人。

exercises.point: 用疑问代词的问句(1)：什么、哪 · Question words 什么 / 哪
exercises.es: What is this?
exercises.rule: The question word takes the place of the information being asked about; the word order doesn't change.

exercises.point: 用疑问代词的问句(1)：什么、哪 · Question words 什么 / 哪
exercises.instruction: Ask what country he is from
exercises.prompt: 他是美国人。
exercises.es: What country is he from?
exercises.rule: The information is replaced by the question word, without changing the word order.
accepted: 他是哪国人？

exercises.point: 用疑问代词的问句(1)：什么、哪 · Question words 什么 / 哪
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 什么是这？
exercises.es: What is this?
exercises.rule: The word order is the same as in the answer (这是饺子 → 这是什么).
accepted: 这是什么？

exercises.point: 连词“和” · The conjunction 和
exercises.pinyin: Bàba hé māma dōu hěn máng.
exercises.es: Mom and Dad are both very busy.
exercises.rule: 和 links nouns and pronouns.

exercises.point: 连词“和” · The conjunction 和
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 我很忙和很累。
exercises.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, yě hěn lèi.
exercises.es: I'm very busy and very tired.
exercises.rule: 和 doesn't link clauses and almost never links verbs or adjectives.
accepted: 我很忙，也很累。

exercises.point: 副词“都”的位置 · Position of 都
exercises.pinyin: Bāozi hé jiǎozi dōu hěn hǎochī.
exercises.es: Both the baozi and the jiaozi are delicious.
exercises.rule: 都 goes after the (plural) subject and before the verb/adjective.

exercises.point: 副词“都”的位置 · Position of 都
exercises.prompt: 都 / 也 / 我们 / 很忙
exercises.es: We're all very busy too.
exercises.rule: If both appear: 也都 (never 都也).
exercises.context: We're all very busy too.
accepted: 我们也都很忙。

exercises.prompt: Politely ask an older person their surname.
exercises.es: What is your surname, please?
exercises.rule: 您贵姓？ is the polite form; answer: 我姓……
accepted: 您贵姓？

exercises.prompt: I'm Spanish.
exercises.rule: Nationality = country + 人.
accepted: 我是西班牙人。

exercises.es: She doesn't have any younger sisters.
exercises.rule: 有 = to have. Negative: 没有 (never 不有).

exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 我不有哥哥。
exercises.es: I don't have any older brothers.
exercises.rule: 有 is negated with 没.
accepted: 我没有哥哥。

exercises.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào yǒu hěn duō xuésheng.
exercises.es: There are many students at our school.
exercises.rule: Place/organization + 有 = there is/are.

exercises.point: 表领属关系的定语 · Possessive modifier with 的
exercises.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen jiā de zhàopiān.
exercises.es: This is a photo of our family.
exercises.rule: Noun/pronoun + 的 + noun = possession.

exercises.point: 表领属关系的定语 · Possessive modifier with 的
exercises.prompt: my mother / our school
exercises.rule: With family members, workplace or home, 的 is usually omitted.
accepted: 我妈妈 / 我们学校

exercises.point: 数量词做定语 · Number + measure word
exercises.es: I have two older sisters.
exercises.rule: Number + measure word + noun. 个 is the general measure word.

exercises.point: 数量词做定语 · Number + measure word
exercises.es: three photos
exercises.rule: 张: measure word for flat objects (photos, tables, banknotes…).

exercises.point: 数量词做定语 · Number + measure word
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 我有三照片。
exercises.es: I have three photos.
exercises.rule: A measure word is needed between a number and a noun.
accepted: 我有三张照片。

exercises.point: 数量词做定语 · Number + measure word
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 我有二个哥哥。
exercises.es: I have two older brothers.
exercises.rule: Before a measure word, «2» is 两, not 二.
accepted: 我有两个哥哥。

exercises.point: 用疑问代词的问句(2)：谁、几 · Question words 谁 / 几
exercises.es: Who is that?
exercises.rule: 谁 asks about people; the word order doesn't change.

exercises.point: 用疑问代词的问句(2)：谁、几 · Question words 谁 / 几
exercises.pinyin: Nǐmen jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
exercises.es: How many people are there in your family?
exercises.rule: 几 + measure word asks about small numbers (usually < 10). 口: measure word for family members.

exercises.point: 还(1)：表示补充 · 还 = also, in addition
exercises.answer: 我有两个姐姐，还有一个哥哥。
exercises.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng ge jiějie, hái yǒu yí ge gēge.
exercises.es: I have two older sisters, and also an older brother.
exercises.rule: 还 adds information: «also, in addition».

exercises.prompt: Your home is really beautiful!
exercises.rule: 真 + adjective = exclamation.
accepted: 你们家真漂亮！
你家真漂亮！

exercises.point: 称数法 · 几 and 多少
exercises.answer: 你们班一共有多少学生？
exercises.pinyin: Nǐmen bān yígòng yǒu duōshao xuésheng?
exercises.es: How many students are there in your class altogether?
exercises.rule: 多少: any quantity (usually ≥ 10); the measure word is optional. 几: < 10, with a measure word.

exercises.point: 称数法 · 几 and 多少
exercises.prompt: You're asking about the number of students at a university: 几 or 多少?
exercises.rule: 几 for small numbers (< 10) with a measure word; 多少 for any number.
accepted: 多少

exercises.point: 钟点读法 · Telling the time
exercises.prompt: It's five to three.
exercises.rule: 差 = «short of»: 差 + minutes + hour.
accepted: 差五分三点。
两点五十五分
两点五十五

exercises.point: 钟点读法 · Telling the time
exercises.prompt: A quarter past two.
exercises.rule: 刻 = quarter of an hour; 2 o'clock is 两点.
accepted: 两点一刻。
两点十五分
两点十五

exercises.point: 钟点读法 · Telling the time
exercises.prompt: Five past eight.
exercises.rule: If 分 is omitted with minutes < 10, 零 is needed: 八点零五.
accepted: 八点五分。
八点零五分
八点零五

exercises.point: 表时间的词语做状语 · Time expressions
exercises.prompt: 有 / 八点半 / 我 / 语法课 / 明天上午
exercises.answer: 我明天上午八点半有语法课。
exercises.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ bā diǎn bàn yǒu yǔfǎ kè.
exercises.es: Tomorrow at eight thirty in the morning I have grammar class.
exercises.rule: Time goes before the verb (after or before the subject), from largest to smallest unit. Never at the end.
exercises.note: 明天上午八点半我有语法课。
exercises.context: Tomorrow at eight thirty in the morning I have grammar class.
accepted: 我明天上午八点半有语法课。
明天上午八点半我有语法课。

exercises.point: 表时间的词语做状语 · Time expressions
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 我有课明天。
exercises.es: I have class tomorrow.
exercises.rule: A point in time (when) never goes after the verb. Note: duration does go after it (L13).
accepted: 我明天有课。
明天我有课。

exercises.point: 正反疑问句 · Affirmative-negative questions (V不V)
exercises.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān yǒu mei yǒu shíjiān?
exercises.es: Do you have time tomorrow?
exercises.rule: 有 → 有没有.

exercises.point: 正反疑问句 · Affirmative-negative questions (V不V)
exercises.instruction: Ask the same question without 吗
exercises.prompt: 你忙吗？
exercises.es: Are you busy?
exercises.rule: Adjective + 不 + adjective, without 吗.
accepted: 你忙不忙？

exercises.point: 正反疑问句 · Affirmative-negative questions (V不V)
exercises.instruction: Ask the same question without 吗
exercises.prompt: 他是你哥哥吗？
exercises.pinyin: Tā shì bu shì nǐ gēge?
exercises.es: Is he your older brother?
exercises.rule: 是 → 是不是.
accepted: 他是不是你哥哥？

exercises.point: 正反疑问句 · Affirmative-negative questions (V不V)
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 你忙不忙吗？
exercises.es: Are you busy?
exercises.rule: The A-not-A form is not combined with 吗.
accepted: 你忙不忙？

exercises.point: 用“呢”构成的省略问句 · Questions with 呢
exercises.es: I'm fine. And you?
exercises.rule: Noun/pronoun + 呢 repeats the previous question, depending on context.

exercises.es: Let's go together.
exercises.rule: Final 吧 softens: suggestion, request or advice.

exercises.prompt: Politely turn down a proposal.
exercises.es: I'm afraid I can't.
exercises.rule: 恐怕 = «I'm afraid that»; polite refusal.
accepted: 恐怕不行。

exercises.prompt: By the way, do you have time tomorrow evening?
exercises.answer: 对了，你明天晚上有没有时间？
exercises.pinyin: Duì le, nǐ míngtiān wǎnshang yǒu mei yǒu shíjiān?
exercises.rule: 对了 changes the subject or introduces something just remembered.
accepted: 对了，你明天晚上有没有时间？

exercises.es: You're Lin Na, right?
exercises.rule: 吧 at the end of a question = assumption («I suppose…»). Different from the 吧 of suggestion.

exercises.prompt: Today is Friday, December 25.
exercises.answer: 今天十二月二十五号，星期五。
exercises.pinyin: Jīntiān shí'èr yuè èrshíwǔ hào, xīngqī wǔ.
exercises.rule: Order: year → month → day → day of the week → part of the day → time (largest to smallest).
accepted: 今天十二月二十五号，星期五。

exercises.prompt: the year 2020 (spoken)
exercises.rule: Years are read digit by digit: èr líng èr líng nián.
accepted: 二〇二〇年

exercises.prompt: He is twenty this year.
exercises.rule: Age, date, time and price can be the predicate without 是.
accepted: 他今年二十岁。

exercises.prompt: 今天五号。
exercises.es: Today isn't the 5th.
exercises.rule: In the negative, 不是 is needed.
accepted: 今天不是五号。

exercises.point: 双宾语动词谓语句(1)：送、教 · Double objects
exercises.prompt: 我 / 英语 / 她 / 教
exercises.es: She teaches me English.
exercises.rule: Verb + person + thing.
exercises.context: She teaches me English.
accepted: 她教我英语。

exercises.point: 双宾语动词谓语句(1)：送、教 · Double objects
exercises.prompt: I give my friend a book (as a gift).
exercises.pinyin: Wǒ sòng péngyou yì běn shū.
exercises.rule: 送 + person + thing.
accepted: 我送朋友一本书。
我送给朋友一本书。

exercises.es: That's my older brother! (the very one I meant)
exercises.rule: 就 before the verb adds emphasis: «exactly, precisely».

exercises.prompt: You're surprised: you know my younger sister?
exercises.es: You know my sister?
exercises.rule: Statement with rising intonation = surprise or doubt.
accepted: 你认识我妹妹？

exercises.point: Notes L5 · 多大 / 几岁
exercises.prompt: Ask a young adult their age.
exercises.rule: 几岁 only for children; 多大 for young people/adults; 您多大年纪 for older people.
accepted: 你多大？
你今年多大？

exercises.point: Notes L5 · 咱们 / 我们
exercises.prompt: Suggest to your classmate that the two of you go eat.
exercises.es: Let's go eat!
exercises.rule: 咱们 always includes the listener; 我们 may or may not.
accepted: 咱们去吃饭吧！
我们去吃饭吧！

exercises.prompt: Let me introduce you all.
exercises.rule: Verb + 一下 = do something a little / briefly.
accepted: 我来介绍一下。

exercises.prompt: Happy birthday!
exercises.rule: 祝 + person + wish.
accepted: 祝你生日快乐！

exercises.es: The bank is east of the library.
exercises.rule: 里边、外边、上边、下边、前边、后边、左边、右边、旁边、东/西/南/北边、对面.

exercises.es: There's a bank at the school.
exercises.rule: Single-syllable forms (里、上…) attach to the noun: 学校里、楼上.

exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 我在中国里边学习。
exercises.es: I study in China.
exercises.rule: 里边 is not used with countries and cities.
accepted: 我在中国学习。

exercises.point: 用“在”表方位 · Location with 在
exercises.es: The library isn't west of the cafeteria.
exercises.rule: Person/thing + 在 + place. Negative: 不在.

exercises.point: 用“有”“是”表存在 · Existence with 有 / 是
exercises.pinyin: Xuéxiào lǐbian yǒu yí ge yínháng.
exercises.es: Inside the school there is a bank.
exercises.rule: Place + 有 + something non-specific («there is a…»).

exercises.point: 用“有”“是”表存在 · Existence with 有 / 是

segments.text: （What's the building next door?）食堂旁边

exercises.answer: 食堂旁边是我们的办公楼。
exercises.pinyin: Shítáng pángbian shì wǒmen de bàngōnglóu.
exercises.es: Next to the cafeteria is our office building.
exercises.rule: Place + 是 + something: identifies what is there. Place + 有 only says that something exists.

exercises.point: 用“有”“是”表存在 · Existence with 有 / 是
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 学校里边有那个银行。
exercises.es: That bank is inside the school.
exercises.rule: Something specific (那个…) is located with 在, not with 有.
accepted: 那个银行在学校里边。

exercises.point: 介词结构(1)：跟 / 给 · 跟 and 给
exercises.es: Come with me.
exercises.rule: 跟 + person = with. It goes before the verb.

exercises.point: 介词结构(1)：跟 / 给 · 跟 and 给
exercises.es: Let me introduce you.
exercises.rule: 给 + person = to/for. It goes before the verb.

exercises.point: 介词结构(1)：跟 / 给 · 跟 and 给
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 我介绍一下给你。
exercises.es: Let me introduce you.
exercises.rule: 跟 + person always goes before the verb; so does 给 + beneficiary (给你介绍). But with transfer verbs, 给 goes after: 送给、交给、还给、寄给.
accepted: 我给你介绍一下。

exercises.es: Let's go together, OK?
exercises.rule: ……，好吗？ asks for agreement with a proposal.

exercises.pinyin: Nǐ shì Zhōngguó rén, duì ma?
exercises.es: You're Chinese, right?
exercises.rule: ……，对吗？ confirms something you're almost sure of.

exercises.prompt: Don't worry.
exercises.rule: 别 + verb/adjective = "don't…" (prohibition, advice).
accepted: 别着急。

exercises.point: 百、千的称数法 · Numbers up to 9999
exercises.rule: Before 千 (and often before 百), "2" is said 两.
accepted: 两千一百九十一

exercises.point: 百、千的称数法 · Numbers up to 9999
exercises.rule: A zero in the middle is said 零.
accepted: 三百零五

exercises.point: 百、千的称数法 · Numbers up to 9999
exercises.rule: Several consecutive zeros in the middle are said with a single 零.
accepted: 一千零八

exercises.point: 能愿动词(1)：想、可以 · Auxiliaries 想 / 可以
exercises.es: I want to buy some apples.
exercises.rule: 想 + verb = wish, intention. Negative: 不想.

exercises.point: 能愿动词(1)：想、可以 · Auxiliaries 想 / 可以
exercises.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ shì yí xià ma?
exercises.es: Can I try it on?
exercises.rule: 可以 = permission / possibility. Negative: 不可以 or 不能.

exercises.point: 能愿动词(1)：想、可以 · Auxiliaries 想 / 可以
exercises.prompt: 你想看电影。
exercises.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng kàn diànyǐng?
exercises.es: Do you want to see a movie?
exercises.rule: The auxiliary is repeated, not the main verb.
accepted: 你想不想看电影？
你想看电影吗？

exercises.point: 能愿动词(1)：想、可以 · Auxiliaries 想 / 可以
exercises.instruction: The sentence has a mistake. Correct it.
exercises.prompt: 你想看不看电影？
exercises.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng kàn diànyǐng?
exercises.es: Do you want to see a movie?
exercises.rule: With an auxiliary, the A不A form is made with the auxiliary.
accepted: 你想不想看电影？

exercises.point: 双宾语动词(2)：给、问、找 · Double objects
exercises.prompt: 八块 / 找 / 我 / 您
exercises.es: Here's eight yuan in change.
exercises.rule: 找 + person + amount = give change.
exercises.context: Here's eight yuan in change.
accepted: 我找您八块。

exercises.point: 双宾语动词(2)：给、问、找 · Double objects
exercises.prompt: I want to ask you a question.
exercises.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn nǐ yí ge wèntí.
exercises.rule: 问 + person + thing.
accepted: 我想问你一个问题。

exercises.point: 用疑问代词的问句(3)：怎么 · 怎么 + verb
exercises.es: How do you say this in Chinese?
exercises.rule: 怎么 + verb asks about the manner.

exercises.point: 用疑问代词的问句(3)：怎么 · 怎么 + verb
exercises.es: How much are the strawberries?
exercises.rule: 怎么卖？ = how much is it sold for? The object (topic) goes first.

exercises.prompt: How much is a jin (half a kilo) of apples?
exercises.rule: Item + 多少钱 + 一 + unit. 斤 = 500 g.
accepted: 苹果多少钱一斤？
一斤苹果多少钱？

exercises.prompt: 5.50 yuan (spoken)
